title: Console home at phone width: the launcher's links and buttons are 16–32 px tall, below the 44 px touch target
body:
domain:ui#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUJ19MstFvFhjgiYTu

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from the #29075 audit (phone-width Navigation flow, run record `/mnt/project-files/issue-29075/run-record-before.md`) · filed by `domain:ui#1` · ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** Home is the first screen after sign-in. On a phone, its links are so small that people miss them or tap the wrong one.

**Measured (`origin/main` `6b3ba82c`, real Console, CRM and showcase, 375 and 390 px, step 01, FAIL in all four runs).** Start with a template 170x32, New in Studio 128x32, Browse App Marketplace 159x16, Setup 52x16, My work: Open inbox 63x16, approvals View all 42x16, notifications View all 42x16, View all activity 101x16, recent rows 356x40. The app bar targets on the same page are #29075's.

**Wanted.**
1. Below `sm`, every home launcher link and button meets 44 px (height, or a padded hit area), in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx`, `HomeRail.tsx` and `HomeAppsStrip.tsx`.
2. Desktop is unchanged.
3. No new keys or options.

**Tests.** A phone-width render test that asserts the phone classes on each target.

**Reader.** `domain:ui` (`area:home`). Size S.

**Dedupe.** Searched `home launcher touch target`, `home page phone`: no product card.

Links back: #29075, #29040.
